IC1: Cardio-vascular pathologies [OR], evoluting [OR] and uncontrolled [OR], (severe HTA [OR]), cardiac deficiency [OR], severe angor [OR], severe arrhythmia.
IC2: Infectious pathologies evoluting [OR] and requiring antibiotherapy.
IC4: Transplanted [OR] patients or patients suffering from severe auto-immune disease.
IC5: Psychiatric troubles that do not allow the protocol follow-up.
